A few caveats:
- **Data freshness varies.** The pages I saw were last updated anywhere from about 22 to about 216 days before today, so check the age before relying on a specific figure.
- **Methodology is unclear.** The search results don't explain how flyindex.org collects its wait-time data, so I can't confirm how representative the numbers are.
- **Some airports have gaps.** Some tables show missing hours, particularly late at night, so not every airport has complete coverage.

I didn't find an official TSA source for hourly historical wait times in these results, so flyindex.org is the best match I found.
